##### Project general facts

Veda by AUM Development is an exclusive low-rise residential building built around a wellness lifestyle concept, where every detail supports comfort, health and harmony. Contemporary architecture with clean lines and panoramic windows gives the building a calm, refined presence, while it rises above a basement level and a ground floor to four residential floors and a rooftop. The collection offers spacious one- and two-bedroom apartments with high ceilings, created with families and modern professionals in mind.

Amenities are curated to support wellness in every form. Residents enjoy adult and children's pools, an indoor gym overlooking the pool, outdoor fitness and a rooftop jogging track, along with yoga and Pilates areas and a rooftop Zen garden and Zen lounge. A spa zone with a sauna and cold plunge ice bath supports recovery, while an outdoor cinema and party deck, lounge areas, children's play areas and parking complete the shared offer for residents and their guests.

Interiors combine premium finishes with spacious, well-planned layouts, high ceilings and panoramic windows that frame views of the neighbouring park and fill every home with natural light. Generous living areas open onto balconies, while bedrooms provide calm, private retreats. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and making every apartment easy to personalise.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Circle is a vibrant, family-friendly community at the centre of the city, known for its circular layout of landscaped parks, low- and mid-rise residential buildings and townhouses. Circle Mall, the JVC park network, neighbourhood cafes, supermarkets, nurseries, schools and clinics cover daily needs close to home and give the community a green, relaxed character.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road connect residents with the wider city. Dubai Miracle Garden and Dubai Hills Mall are a short drive away, Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence and Mall of the Emirates are close by, and Palm Jumeirah, Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable reach.

Jumeirah Village Circle is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the most popular rental markets in Dubai. A central position between the coastal districts and the inland business hubs attracts young professionals and families, supporting high occupancy and steady demand. Boutique buildings with resort-style amenities and competitive prices underpin attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners.
